summary: Iter-138 UI unification of cumulative salary numbers across 5 pages verified. New shared <EmployeeBalanceCard/> + <SalaryAccrualSummaryCard/> read from /api/liabilities/salary-accrual-summary and render identical values on FinancialInputHub (pay-liab + advance tabs), OperationsDashboard, OperationalReports (monthly/yearly), and OperatingExpenses (Salaries tab). Cross-page consistency for the 4 active employees (عرفات / خالد / عزوز / ابو جمال) is exact. No regressions detected on existing OperatingExpenses CRUD.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (NOT introduced by iter-138) React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from emergent x-* dynamic instrumentation injected into <option> elements inside the bank/account <select> in FinancialInputHub. Harmless console noise but worth tracking globally.

EmployeeBalanceCard re-fetches the full /salary-accrual-summary on every employeeId change. For pages that already render SalaryAccrualSummaryCard (e.g. OperationsDashboard) the same endpoint is called twice on first render. Minor — consider a lightweight context/cache if perf becomes an issue with many employees.

seed_data_creation: None — used live merchant data already present in preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route names: OperationsDashboard lives at /operations-dashboard (NOT /operations). OperationalReports at /operational-reports. FinancialInputHub at /financial-input-hub. Default period on OperationalReports is 'daily' (opreport-salary-accrual section hidden by design). Use [data-testid='opreport-period-monthly'] / [data-testid='opreport-period-yearly'] buttons to switch. PayLiabilityForm: only liabilities with employee_salary_id render the new card — search 'عرفات' in pay-liability-search picks a salary liability that has it set. AdvanceForm: pick via [data-testid='adv-employee-pick-{id}']. The card briefly shows employee-balance-card-loading before settling to employee-balance-card.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. All 5 wiring points render the unified component, fetch the same canonical endpoint, and display identical numbers down to two decimals. Hidden-on-daily behaviour on OperationalReports works (section absent on daily, present on monthly and yearly). Existing legacy cards (adv-cumulative-card, pay-liability-balance-card, oe-add-salary-btn) remain intact — no regressions.
